text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
But I can't stop yet! No first-rate<n>runner would quit
so early!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha. King's still at it, huh?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I can begin cooling<n>down after
witnessing such a fiery<n>display of passion!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep training! I want to explore<n>just how far I
can push my limits!
choice_data_list:
We'd better call it a day. You'll end up overworking
yourself otherwise.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Thank you! All right, I'll be right back!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You've got guts, King! But can you<n>keep up with my
brilliance?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I hope you enjoy playing catch-up,<n>because that's
all you'll be doing<n>with me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. I can't aim for the<n>world stage with
blind determination<n>alone. But I also can't just
stand<n>here and watch her run...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I can use my pent-up passion to<n>cheer for her!
